adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the Playwright expected webhook payload from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []` (apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts), which only tracks the schema/output change for an empty destination calendar case. Meanwhile, substantial new behavior was introduced to support `destinationCalendar` as an array and to create/update/delete events across multiple destinations/credentials (e.g., packages/core/EventManager.ts `createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, and multiple places treat the first element as “mainHostDestinationCalendar”). The updated test assertion does not exercise or validate that new multi-destination/multi-host logic, so it can be seen as a shape-only snapshot adjustment rather than coverage of the intended fix.
